learning_outcomes.text: has deepened knowledge in the field of power engineering
is able to obtain information from literature, databases and other sources; is able to integrate the acquired information, interpret it, draw conclusions, and formulate and justify opinions
is able to prepare and present a short presentation on the results of the engineering task implementation
understands the need and knows the possibilities of continuous self-education and raising one's professional competences

syllabus_topics: General structure of the diploma project.
Rules for editorial development of diploma projects.
General characteristics of literature selection and use in project preparation.
General characteristics of the form of the diploma examination.
Ways of presenting the work during the diploma examination.
Reporting the content of diploma projects prepared by students.
Discussion concerning the presented research results included in the diploma projects.
assessment_rules: The credit conditions are the preparation and presentation of a presentation and mandatory attendance. The evaluation of student work can be based on oral or written statements in the form of colloquium, which, in accordance with AGH study regulations, translates into the final grade for this form of classes. Students are required to prepare for classes in the scope indicated by the instructor (e.g., in the form of task sets).
